landing_page.hero: Split layout: Left text (H1 + Sub + CTA), Right Image (Architecture). Background: Subtle gradient.
landing_page.features: Bento Grid (Mode A). Mix of large feature cards and smaller stat cards.
landing_page.how_it_works: Step-by-step vertical timeline or horizontal cards with connecting lines.

community_feed.structure: Two-column layout. Main feed (Left/Center, 2/3 width), Sidebar (Right, 1/3 width) for Trending/Filters.
community_feed.card_style: HelloTalk vibe. User avatar prominent, content clear, interaction bar at bottom. 'Moments' style.

issue_tracker.structure: Nolt-style board. Clean list or grid of cards. Status indicator top right. Upvote button prominent on left.
issue_tracker.filters: Horizontal scrollable tab list at top.

assets.icons: Use Lucide React (default). For specific civic icons, use Heroicons if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'Outfit' font via Google Fonts in index.css.
2. THEME: Update tailwind.config.js with the specific color palette provided above. Do not rely on default shadcn slate.
3. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn UI for all interactive elements (Dialog, Form, Select, Tabs). Customize the radius to '0.75rem'.
4. LAYOUT: Implement the 'Bento Grid' for the landing page features section as specified in the E1 persona.
5. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every button, input, and card has a unique data-testid (e.g., 'submit-issue-btn', 'feed-card-1').
6. MOTION: Add 'framer-motion' for page transitions and list entrance animations (staggered fade-in).
7. GLASSMORPHISM: Use 'backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80' for the sticky navbar.
8. STATUS: Use the specific color combinations for status chips defined in 'components.status_chips'.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI Slop' designs. Use asymmetry and generous spacing.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
